description: This is a Java unit test file for the class DefaultWebsocketConfig in the org.eclipse.ditto.services.gateway.util.config.streaming package. It contains tests verifying the immutability, equality, default values, and property loading of the DefaultWebsocketConfig class using JUnit and AssertJ. The file also tests the rendering and reconstruction of configuration objects.

classes.name: DefaultWebsocketConfigTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing the DefaultWebsocketConfig class for correctness, default value handling, equality, and rendering based on configuration files.

methods.name: initTestFixture
methods.description: Initializes the static configuration used in tests by loading 'websocket-test' configuration file.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that DefaultWebsocketConfig instances are immutable and that ThrottlingConfig is also immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Uses EqualsVerifier to ensure the correctness of equals and hashCode implementations of DefaultWebsocketConfig.

methods.name: underTestReturnsDefaultValuesIfBaseConfigWasEmpty
methods.description: Checks that when ConfigFactory.empty() is used, the DefaultWebsocketConfig returns default values.

methods.name: underTestReturnsValuesOfConfigFile
methods.description: Verifies that the configuration values are correctly loaded from the test configuration file.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Tests rendering the configuration to a Config object and reconstructing it to verify consistency.
